name: Shinonome Yuhan
source:
Yuhan is from a small, rural village in the east. He's a former major of the Sardeis family, which he acquired at a young age due to his exceptional intelligence and military prowess. However, for some reason, he has since become a butler at Devil's Palace.

[Translated from [url=https://www.devilbutler.com/%E3%83%A6%E3%83%BC%E3%83%8F%E3%83%B3]official website[/url]]
